source.ruleset: Diablo II: Resurrected — Reign of the Warlock
source.note: Reign-of-the-Warlock addendum to the LoD policy. These codes are inert in a Lord of Destruction game, so the pass stays safe for LoD-only players.

wa6: hides Measured Wrath, the exceptional-tier Warlock unique
wad: hides Horazon's Secrets, the Horazon's Splendor set grimoire
waf: hides Ars Al'Diabolos, the level-85 Warlock unique

Vigilance.note: The only runeword that accepts a grimoire also accepts generic shields, Necromancer heads and Paladin shields, so hiding the grimoire line never removes the only shell for it.
